title: Internal Hom from a finite-free retract is exact at independent universes
statement: Let R be a commutative coefficient sheaf on a site with independent object and morphism universes c,v, with modules in max c v r and the usual sheafification hypotheses [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. If E is a retract of a finite product O^n, then internal Hom(E,-) [def-pur-sheaf-hom] sends every short exact sequence to a short exact sequence. The splitting is the termwise splitting used by [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package].

proof.text: Evaluation at 1 identifies Hom(O,N) naturally with N. Contravariant additivity and the finite biproduct comparison identify Hom(O^n,N) naturally with the finite sum of n copies of N. Verify the projection formula and naturality by precomposition with each standard product inclusion.

Finite direct sums preserve short exact sequences: the finite discrete colimit functor is also a limit functor, so it is exact. Transport this sequence along the constructed natural product-Hom isomorphisms.

Apply internal Hom to the given splitting E to O^n to E. It gives a retract of short complexes, hence a retract on homology. The larger homology is zero, and the smaller identity factors through that zero object. Monomorphisms and epimorphisms are stable under retracts, completing short exactness.
